description.value: Sea Wolf Adventures is an Indigenous-led wildlife and cultural tour operator run by members of the Kwakwaka'wakw people, operating out of the Broughton Archipelago and Great Bear Rainforest in Northern Vancouver Island. The company offers all-inclusive lodge packages and day tours featuring grizzly bear viewing, whale watching, and First Nations cultural experiences guided by people whose families have stewarded this territory for millennia. It stands out as one of the few operators offering authentic Indigenous-guided wilderness safaris in this remote coastal region.

It is a notable attraction in a remote area of Northern Vancouver Island that touring cyclists travelling the region may wish to visit.
